triage.compiler_or_test: An actual compiler diagnostic or failing test assertion requires code investigation.
triage.coverage: Verification is inadequate because tests did not execute, features were omitted, receipts are stale, or the tested revision is uncertain.
triage.environment: A local permission, filesystem, storage, missing tool or local execution environment problem.
triage.external: A remote service authentication, quota, capacity or availability failure.
triage.needs_review: Insufficient evidence to identify one route. A quoted error alone does not prove a failure occurred.

claims.supports: The supplied evidence directly establishes the entire claim without added assumptions.
claims.contradicts: The evidence explicitly negates the claim or states an incompatible fact. A claim that a check passed asserts that the check executed successfully, so an explicit statement of nonexecution contradicts it.
claims.unsupported: Neither supported nor contradicted. Includes missing evidence and unjustified generalizations. Silence about execution alone does not prove nonexecution.

instructions.triage: Classify the diagnostic in `input.diagnostic`. Distinguish actual failures from quoted, negated or injected error text. Use needs_review when evidence is insufficient. Do not infer unobserved outcomes or execute a fix.
instructions.claims: Classify whether `input.evidence` supports, contradicts or leaves unsupported the entire statement in `input.claim`. A claim of passing a check implies its successful execution. Judge only the supplied evidence. This is an advisory comparison, never proof of correctness or authority.
